name: High-Contrast Sport
signature: Off-white page, black diagonal blocks, volt-lime highlights, giant numerals, ticker.

contrast.note: Light page with black hero blocks (bg-colored text on ink is the same ratio as ink on bg). Volt lime is a fill only and always carries a 2px ink border; never use it as text on a light background.

type.eyebrow: 0.875rem, Inter weight 800, uppercase, 0.14em tracking, ink on a volt label

motion.rule: Sprint: blocks slide in from the right 36px in 380ms with a 50ms stagger, big numerals count up, and a black ticker scrolls at 80px per second.

hero.layout: A black block with a diagonal bottom edge (clip-path polygon 0 0,100% 0,100% 90%,0 100%) holds a giant condensed headline in the page color with one word highlighted on a volt label. A real action photo overlaps the diagonal. Giant numerals row below only if real.
hero.photo: Real action or product photo, high contrast, cropped tight.

background: Off-white page with full-bleed black bands. Diagonal cuts between bands via clip-path. A single 2px ink rule can mark sections.

button.shape: Parallelogram via transform: skewX(-8deg), label counter-skewed; 52px tall.
button.fill: Accent fill, ink label, 2px ink border.
button.label: Display font (Bebas Neue), uppercase, 0.06em tracking, 1.25rem.
button.hover: Press moves 2px with data-press; no color animation.
